# opnsense_acmeclient_action (Data Source)

Retrieves an ACME Client restart action from the OPNsense os-acme-client plugin by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_acmeclient_action" "example" {
  id = "<uuid>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the restart action.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description for this restart action.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this restart action is enabled.
- `name` (String) Display name for the restart action.
- `type` (String) Action type.
